summary: Matchering is a self-hosted audio utility designed to automate the process of mastering music tracks. It functions as an open-source alternative to commercial cloud services like LANDR and eMastered, processing audio files directly on your own hardware.
goodFor: It is well-suited for audio engineers, producers, or developers who want to experiment with automated audio mastering without relying on proprietary online subscriptions.
watchOut: The project exhibits low maintenance activity and an older release history, meaning you may encounter unresolved bugs or lack updates for newer audio formats and dependencies.
deployNotes: As it is packaged with Docker, you will typically need to configure persistent volumes for input and output audio files, alongside a reverse proxy if you plan to expose a web interface.
